question: 고객 이탈률은?
pred_sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_cnt = 1 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_rate
FROM customer_order_counts;
sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(last_order < '2018-03-01') / COUNT(*), 2) AS churn_rate
FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order
      FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
      GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id)
